caption:
Advertised scooter range assumes a light rider, low speed, flat ground. Plan on half to two-thirds of it, keep a mechanical brake besides regen, and look for UL 2272. Claude goes with the Segway Ninebot Max line; GPT names a model, the MAX G2. Budget and hill picks: 1billionmodels.com/electric-scooters

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: How far will an electric scooter really go?
